# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in this project, please report it privately by email to [Matheus Costa Vieira](mailto:matheus.vieira@thoughtworks.com).

Please include:

- A description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce the issue
- Potential impact or exploit scenario
- Any relevant code or configuration details

## Response Process

The maintainers will review security reports as soon as possible and respond with next steps. Please allow time for investigation before publicly disclosing any issues.

## Supported Versions

This repository is currently maintained on the `main` branch. Security fixes will be applied promptly when valid reports are received.

## Disclosure Policy

If the vulnerability is confirmed, maintainers may coordinate disclosure and remediation before making the issue public.
